name: bricksurance-data-core
title: Bricksurance Data Core
description: An open, business-first semantic data model for insurance, aligned to ACORD terminology with a crosswalk to the Lloyd's Core Data Record. Platform artifacts are generated from these specs; see bindings/ and tools/.
standards_basis: Aligned to ACORD terminology with a Lloyd's Core Data Record crosswalk. Element names are cited as a crosswalk only; licensed standards are not reproduced.

domains.name: reference
domains.description: Shared code sets and classifications used across all domains, plus the generated data dictionary. Reference data is versioned with the model: allowed values live in the specs, not in anyone's head.

domains.name: party
domains.description: People and organisations, and the roles they play in the business (insured, broker, cedant, reinsurer, claimant). A party exists once; relationships are roles.

domains.name: policy
domains.description: Insurance contracts and their composition - policies, coverages, insured objects and premium transactions.

domains.name: claim
domains.description: Claims against policies and their financial development - reserves, payments and recoveries as transactions, never as overwritten balances.

domains.name: reinsurance
domains.description: Outward and inward reinsurance - treaties, cessions and recoveries linking the direct book to reinsurers.

domains.name: life
domains.description: Life business - grouped model points, governed assumption sets, economic scenario sets and valuation runs. Life policies themselves are ordinary policies with life lines of business.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Financial and regulatory measures - valuation results across regimes (Solvency II, IFRS 17) and lines of business, always tied to an auditable valuation run.

domains.name: exchange
domains.description: Canonical data-exchange objects (bordereau lines, submissions) and the landing zone for inbound counterparty data before mapping to the canonical model.

domains.name: semantics
domains.description: Business metrics defined once over the canonical model - gross written premium, net earned premium, incurred, loss ratio, combined ratio. Physicalised as metric views where the platform supports them.

code_sets.name: assumption_status
code_sets.title: Assumption Status
code_sets.description: Maker/checker lifecycle of an assumption set. Only one set per assumption type is APPROVED and in force at a time; superseded sets remain queryable for reproducibility.

codes.label: Draft
codes.description: Being prepared by the maker; not usable in valuations.

codes.label: Pending Approval
codes.description: Submitted for checker approval.

codes.label: Approved
codes.description: Approved and in force for valuation runs.

codes.label: Rejected
codes.description: Rejected by the checker; retained for audit.

codes.label: Superseded
codes.description: Replaced by a newer approved set; retained for reproducibility.

code_sets.name: assumption_type
code_sets.title: Assumption Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of actuarial assumption governed through the assumption-set maker/checker process.

codes.label: Mortality
codes.description: Mortality rates by age, typically expressed against a standard table.

codes.label: Lapse
codes.description: Policy discontinuance rates by duration.

codes.label: Expense
codes.description: Per-policy and percentage expense loadings.

codes.label: Economic
codes.description: Economic assumptions such as discount and inflation bases.

code_sets.name: cause_of_loss
code_sets.title: Cause of Loss
code_sets.description: The peril or event that gave rise to a claim. Aligned to ACORD cause-of-loss vocabulary; one primary cause per claim.

codes.label: Fire
codes.description: Fire, including smoke damage and firefighting damage.

codes.label: Flood
codes.description: Inundation from external water, including river and surface water flooding.

codes.label: Storm
codes.description: Windstorm, hail and associated weather damage.

codes.label: Water Damage
codes.description: Escape of water from internal systems such as burst pipes.

codes.label: Theft
codes.description: Theft, attempted theft and malicious damage in connection with it.

codes.label: Collision
codes.description: Impact of a vehicle with another vehicle or object.

codes.label: Liability Incident
codes.description: An event giving rise to third-party injury or property damage.

code_sets.name: claim_status
code_sets.title: Claim Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle status of a claim. Financial development lives in claim transactions; status describes the handling state only.

codes.label: Open
codes.description: Claim reported and under active handling.

codes.label: Closed
codes.description: Claim settled and closed; reserves released or exhausted.

codes.label: Reopened
codes.description: Previously closed claim reopened for further development.

codes.label: Declined
codes.description: Claim declined as not covered; no indemnity payable.

code_sets.name: claim_transaction_type
code_sets.title: Claim Transaction Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of claim financial movement. Claims finance is transactional: case reserves, payments and recoveries are signed movements, and figures such as outstanding or incurred are always derived by summation.

standards.acord: Claim payment / reserve patterns of the ACORD Information Model

codes.label: Case Reserve Movement
codes.description: Signed change to the case reserve estimate. The current outstanding reserve is the sum of these movements less indemnity payments.

codes.label: Indemnity Payment
codes.description: Payment to the claimant in settlement of the insured loss.

codes.label: Expense Payment
codes.description: Allocated loss adjustment expense, such as legal or surveyor fees.

codes.label: Recovery
codes.description: Amount recovered by subrogation, salvage or contribution; negative from the insurer's cost perspective.

code_sets.name: country
code_sets.title: Country
code_sets.description: Countries the group operates or insures risks in, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. A governed subset, extended when the business enters a market.

codes.label: United Kingdom
codes.description: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.

codes.label: Ireland
codes.description: Republic of Ireland.

codes.label: Germany
codes.description: Federal Republic of Germany.

codes.label: France
codes.description: French Republic.

codes.label: Switzerland
codes.description: Swiss Confederation.

codes.label: United States
codes.description: United States of America.

code_sets.name: coverage_type
code_sets.title: Coverage Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of cover that can be granted under a policy. A policy bundles one or more coverages; limits, deductibles and claims attach at coverage level.

codes.label: Buildings
codes.description: Physical damage to buildings and fixed structures.

codes.label: Contents
codes.description: Physical damage to contents, stock and equipment.

codes.label: Business Interruption
codes.description: Loss of income and increased cost of working following insured physical damage.

codes.label: Motor Own Damage
codes.description: Damage to the insured vehicle itself.

codes.label: Motor Third-Party Liability
codes.description: Liability to third parties arising from use of the insured vehicle.

codes.label: Public Liability
codes.description: Liability to third parties for injury or property damage arising from business operations.

codes.label: Cargo
codes.description: Loss of or damage to goods in transit.

code_sets.name: currency
code_sets.title: Currency
code_sets.description: Transaction currencies used by the group, as ISO 4217 alphabetic codes. This is deliberately a governed subset, not the full ISO list: a currency is added here when the business starts writing in it.

codes.label: Pound Sterling
codes.description: United Kingdom pound sterling.

codes.label: Euro
codes.description: Euro.

codes.label: US Dollar
codes.description: United States dollar.

codes.label: Swiss Franc
codes.description: Swiss franc.

code_sets.name: endorsement_type
code_sets.title: Endorsement Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of mid-term change to a policy. The premium effect of an endorsement is always booked as premium transactions; the endorsement records the contractual change itself.

codes.label: Mid-term Adjustment
codes.description: General adjustment to terms during the policy period.

codes.label: Coverage Change
codes.description: Cover added, removed or amended.

codes.label: Sum Insured Change
codes.description: Declared values increased or decreased.

codes.label: Extension
codes.description: Cover period extended beyond the original expiry.

codes.label: Cancellation
codes.description: Policy terminated before natural expiry.

code_sets.name: insured_object_type
code_sets.title: Insured Object Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of object or exposure a policy can insure. Extend with new codes as new lines of business are written (vessels, livestock, cyber estates...).

standards.acord: InsuredObject / Risk patterns of the ACORD Information Model

codes.label: Building
codes.description: A building or fixed structure at a defined location.

codes.label: Vehicle
codes.description: A road vehicle.

codes.label: Cargo Shipment
codes.description: A defined consignment of goods in transit.

codes.label: Liability Exposure
codes.description: An abstract exposure unit for liability covers, such as a set of business operations at a location.

code_sets.name: line_of_business
code_sets.title: Line of Business
code_sets.description: Classes of insurance business written by the group, aligned to ACORD LOBCd vocabulary. Extend by adding codes; never repurpose an existing code.

codes.label: Commercial Property
codes.description: Direct insurance of commercial buildings, contents and consequent business interruption.

codes.label: Motor
codes.description: Direct motor insurance, own damage and third-party liability.

codes.label: General Liability
codes.description: Direct third-party liability other than motor, including public and products liability.

codes.label: Marine Cargo
codes.description: Direct insurance of goods in transit by sea, air or land.

codes.label: Property Treaty Reinsurance
codes.description: Treaty reinsurance of property business, assumed or ceded; the direction is determined by the party roles on the contract, not by this code.

codes.label: Term Life
codes.description: Individual term life protection.

codes.label: Credit Life
codes.description: Life cover written against outstanding credit balances.

codes.label: Group Protection
codes.description: Employer-sponsored group life and disability protection.

codes.label: Annuity
codes.description: Annuities in payment or deferment.

code_sets.name: loss_basis
code_sets.title: Loss Basis
code_sets.description: Whether an event loss figure is modelled or reported. Day-one catastrophe numbers are modelled (event footprint against in-force exposure); cedant reports firm up over the following weeks — the basis keeps the two honest.

codes.label: Modelled
codes.description: Estimated from an event footprint applied to in-force exposure.

codes.label: Reported
codes.description: Reported by the cedant or claims process.

code_sets.name: party_role_type
code_sets.title: Party Role Type
code_sets.description: The roles a party can play in the business. This code set is the model's number-one extension point: a new kind of counterparty is a new code here, not a new table.

standards.acord: Party role patterns of the ACORD Information Model

codes.label: Policyholder
codes.description: The party that entered into the policy contract and owes the premium.

codes.label: Insured
codes.description: A party whose interest is covered by the policy; often, but not always, the policyholder.

codes.label: Broker
codes.description: An intermediary placing the business on behalf of the policyholder.

codes.label: Claimant
codes.description: The party claiming under a policy; may be a third party.

codes.label: Cedant
codes.description: The insurer ceding risk under a reinsurance contract.

codes.label: Reinsurer
codes.description: The party assuming risk under a reinsurance contract.

codes.label: Coverholder
codes.description: A party authorised to bind business on the insurer's behalf under a delegated authority.

code_sets.name: party_type
code_sets.title: Party Type
code_sets.description: Fundamental legal nature of a party. Everything else about a party's place in the business is a role, never a type.

codes.label: Person
codes.description: A natural person.

codes.label: Organisation
codes.description: A legal entity - company, partnership, public body or association.

code_sets.name: policy_status
code_sets.title: Policy Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle status of a policy contract. Status reflects the contract as a whole; coverage-level suspension is modelled on the coverage entity.

codes.label: Quoted
codes.description: Terms offered to the prospective policyholder; no cover yet in force.

codes.label: Bound
codes.description: Cover agreed and legally binding but inception date not yet reached.

codes.label: In Force
codes.description: Cover currently active; today is within the cover period.

codes.label: Expired
codes.description: Cover period ended at its natural expiry date.

codes.label: Cancelled
codes.description: Cover terminated before natural expiry by either party; return premium may exist as premium transactions.

codes.label: Lapsed
codes.description: Cover terminated for non-payment of premium.

code_sets.name: premium_transaction_type
code_sets.title: Premium Transaction Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of premium movement. Premium is always modelled as signed transactions; balances such as gross written premium are derived by summation, never overwritten.

codes.label: Written Premium
codes.description: Premium written on binding or renewal of cover; positive amount.

codes.label: Adjustment Premium
codes.description: Mid-term or declaration-based premium adjustment; signed amount.

codes.label: Return Premium
codes.description: Premium returned to the policyholder, typically on cancellation; negative amount.

code_sets.name: quote_status
code_sets.title: Quote Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle status of a quotation. A quote that converts is linked to the resulting policy; premium only ever arises on the policy, never the quote.

codes.label: Open
codes.description: Quotation requested and being worked.

codes.label: Offered
codes.description: Terms offered to the prospective policyholder.

codes.label: Converted
codes.description: Offer accepted; a policy has been issued from this quote.

codes.label: Declined by Insurer
codes.description: The insurer declined to offer terms.

codes.label: Rejected by Customer
codes.description: Terms offered but not taken up.

codes.label: Expired
codes.description: Offer lapsed unanswered at its validity date.

code_sets.name: run_verdict
code_sets.title: Run Verdict
code_sets.description: Quality-gate verdict of a processing or valuation run. RED runs never feed downstream consumption; the verdict is part of the auditable run record.

codes.label: Green
codes.description: All quality checks passed; results released downstream.

codes.label: Amber
codes.description: Passed with warnings; released with commentary.

codes.label: Red
codes.description: Quality gate failed; results blocked from downstream use.

code_sets.name: scenario_status
code_sets.title: Scenario Set Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle of an economic scenario set. Exactly one set is ACTIVE for production valuations; others remain AVAILABLE for analysis.

codes.label: Active
codes.description: The scenario set used by production valuation runs.

codes.label: Available
codes.description: Delivered and validated, usable for analysis, not the production set.

codes.label: Superseded
codes.description: Replaced by a newer set; retained for reproducibility.

code_sets.name: source_system
code_sets.title: Source System
code_sets.description: Systems of record that feed the data layer. Provenance is part of the model: every core entity carries a source_system_code, and identifiers are only unique within their source system.

codes.label: Policy Administration (Core)
codes.description: The group's core policy administration system.

codes.label: Claims (Core)
codes.description: The group's core claims management system.

codes.label: Reinsurance (Core)
codes.description: The group's reinsurance administration system.

codes.label: Data Core (Mastered)
codes.description: Records mastered or derived inside the data layer itself, such as deduplicated golden party records.

codes.label: Life Administration (Core)
codes.description: The group's life policy administration and valuation feed.

codes.label: Coverholder Bordereau
codes.description: Lines reported by coverholders or brokers via bordereaux and mapped into the canonical model through the exchange domain.

code_sets.name: submission_status
code_sets.title: Submission Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle of a reinsurance submission from receipt to bind or decline.

codes.label: Received
codes.description: Submission received and awaiting triage.

codes.label: In Review
codes.description: Under triage, pricing and accumulation assessment.

codes.label: Quoted
codes.description: Terms quoted back to the cedant or broker.

codes.label: Bound
codes.description: Accepted and bound; a treaty exists for this submission.

codes.label: Declined
codes.description: Declined by the reinsurer.

codes.label: Withdrawn
codes.description: Withdrawn by the cedant or broker before a decision.

code_sets.name: treaty_type
code_sets.title: Treaty Type
code_sets.description: Forms of treaty reinsurance. Direction (assumed or ceded) is determined by the cedant and reinsurer party roles on the treaty, not by this code.

codes.label: Quota Share
codes.description: Proportional treaty ceding a fixed share of every risk in scope.

codes.label: Surplus
codes.description: Proportional treaty ceding the portion of each risk above the cedant's retained line.

codes.label: Excess of Loss (Per Risk)
codes.description: Non-proportional cover for individual risk losses above an attachment point.

codes.label: Excess of Loss (Catastrophe)
codes.description: Non-proportional cover for accumulated losses from a single catastrophe event.

code_sets.name: valuation_measure
code_sets.title: Valuation Measure
code_sets.description: Financial measures produced by valuation processes across regimes. One code set serves life and non-life, Solvency II and IFRS 17: a measure is a defined quantity, and new regimes add codes, not tables.

standards.lloyds_cdr: n/a — regime measures per Solvency II / IFRS 17 definitions

codes.label: Best Estimate Liability
codes.description: Present value of expected future cash flows, Solvency II best estimate.

codes.label: Risk Margin
codes.description: Solvency II risk margin over the best estimate.

codes.label: Technical Provision
codes.description: Best estimate plus risk margin.

codes.label: Case Reserves (Total)
codes.description: Sum of open case reserves at the valuation date.

codes.label: IBNR
codes.description: Incurred-but-not-reported reserve at the valuation date.

codes.label: Solvency Capital Requirement
codes.description: Solvency II capital requirement.

codes.label: Own Funds
codes.description: Eligible own funds at the valuation date.

codes.label: Contractual Service Margin
codes.description: IFRS 17 contractual service margin.

codes.label: Risk Adjustment
codes.description: IFRS 17 risk adjustment for non-financial risk.

entities.name: claim
entities.title: Claim
entities.description: A demand for indemnity under a policy arising from a loss event. The claim record holds the event and handling state; all financial development lives in claim transactions.
entities.grain: One row per claim per source system.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Stable, source-agnostic identifier for the claim, owned by the data layer.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Policy the claim is made under.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Coverage the claim attaches to, where the source provides it.

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Claim number as issued by the claims system. Unique within a source system - always interpret together with source_system_code.

attributes.name: claim_status_code
attributes.description: Current handling status of the claim.

attributes.name: cause_of_loss_code
attributes.description: Primary peril or event that gave rise to the claim.

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: Date the loss occurred.

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: Date the loss was first reported to the insurer. Must be on or after loss_date.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the loss circumstances.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record the claim originates from.

quality.name: reported_after_loss
quality.description: A loss cannot be reported before it happens.

entities.name: claim_transaction
entities.title: Claim Transaction
entities.description: A signed financial movement on a claim: case reserve movements, indemnity and expense payments, and recoveries. Outstanding, paid and incurred are always derived by summation over these movements, never stored as balances.
entities.grain: One row per financial movement per claim.

standards.acord: Claim payment / reserve patterns of the ACORD Information Model

attributes.name: claim_transaction_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the claim transaction.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Claim the movement belongs to.

attributes.name: claim_transaction_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of financial movement.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Signed amount in the transaction currency. Reserve increases positive, reserve releases negative; payments positive; recoveries negative from the insurer's cost perspective.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the amount.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Date the movement was booked.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record the movement originates from.

entities.name: premium_bordereau_line
entities.title: Premium Bordereau Line (inbound)
entities.description: The canonical form of an inbound premium bordereau line, as reported by a coverholder or broker. Messy source files land in the exchange domain and are mapped into this shape - using the data dictionary as the contract - before flowing into the core model.
entities.grain: One row per policy per reporting month per inbound bordereau.

attributes.name: bordereau_line_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the bordereau line, assigned on ingestion.

attributes.name: reporting_month
attributes.description: First day of the calendar month the bordereau reports on.

attributes.name: coverholder_name
attributes.description: Name of the coverholder or broker submitting the bordereau.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Policy reference as reported by the coverholder; matched to the core model downstream.

attributes.name: insured_name
attributes.description: Name of the insured as reported.

attributes.name: line_of_business_code
attributes.description: Line of business, mapped from the coverholder's own class descriptions to the canonical code set.

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Cover inception as reported.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Cover expiry as reported.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the reported amounts.

attributes.name: gross_premium
attributes.description: Gross written premium reported for the line.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Coverholder commission reported for the line.

attributes.name: risk_country_code
attributes.description: Country of the risk location, where reported.

attributes.name: risk_postcode
attributes.description: Postal code of the risk location, where reported.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Provenance of the line; coverholder bordereaux use COVERHOLDER_BDX.

entities.name: valuation_result
entities.title: Valuation Result
entities.description: A published valuation figure: one measure (BEL, technical provision, IBNR, SCR, CSM...) for one line of business and cohort, produced by exactly one auditable valuation run. One shape serves life and non-life, Solvency II and IFRS 17 - new regimes add measure codes, not tables.
entities.grain: One row per valuation run per line of business per measure per cohort.

attributes.name: valuation_result_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the result row.

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: The run that produced this figure.

attributes.name: line_of_business_code
attributes.description: Line of business the figure relates to.

attributes.name: valuation_measure_code
attributes.description: Which defined measure this figure is.

attributes.name: cohort
attributes.description: Optional sub-division (e.g. an age-by-term band or underwriting-year cohort).

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The figure, in the stated currency. Sign follows the measure's own convention.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the amount.

entities.name: assumption_set
entities.title: Assumption Set
entities.description: A versioned, governed set of actuarial assumptions (mortality, lapse, expense, economic). Sets move through a maker/checker lifecycle; valuation runs record exactly which approved set they used, which is what makes any past result reproducible.
entities.grain: One row per assumption set version per assumption type.

attributes.name: assumption_set_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the assumption set version.

attributes.name: assumption_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of assumption governed by this set.

attributes.name: assumption_status_code
attributes.description: Maker/checker lifecycle status.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Monotonic version number within the assumption type.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: What changed in this version and why.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: First valuation date this set applies to, once approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Checker who approved or rejected the set.

attributes.name: approved_at
attributes.description: When the approval decision was made.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record the assumption set originates from.

entities.name: model_point
entities.title: Model Point
entities.description: A grouped model point for life valuation: policies compressed into cohorts (attained age by outstanding term) at a valuation date. Model points are derived from in-force life policies; the grouping is proven back to the policy count and sum assured it represents.
entities.grain: One row per cohort per line of business per valuation date.

attributes.name: model_point_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the model point.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Valuation date the model point file was cut at.

attributes.name: line_of_business_code
attributes.description: Life line of business the cohort belongs to.

attributes.name: age_attained
attributes.description: Attained age of the cohort at the valuation date.

attributes.name: outstanding_term_years
attributes.description: Remaining policy term of the cohort in whole years.

attributes.name: policy_count
attributes.description: Number of in-force policies grouped into this model point.

attributes.name: sum_assured
attributes.description: Total sum assured of the cohort, in the cohort currency.

attributes.name: annual_premium
attributes.description: Total annualised premium of the cohort.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the monetary amounts.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record the model point file originates from.

quality.name: grouping_proven
quality.rule: sum(policy_count) per valuation_date equals the in-force policy count it was cut from
quality.description: Model point grouping must reconcile exactly to the underlying book.

entities.name: scenario_set
entities.title: Scenario Set
entities.description: A delivered economic scenario set (risk-free curves, equity paths) used by stochastic valuation. Registered with a lifecycle so exactly one set is active for production runs, and every run records which set it used.
entities.grain: One row per delivered scenario set.

attributes.name: scenario_set_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the scenario set.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the set, including its calibration reference.

attributes.name: scenario_status_code
attributes.description: Lifecycle status; exactly one set is ACTIVE for production.

attributes.name: scenario_count
attributes.description: Number of stochastic paths in the set.

attributes.name: calibration_date
attributes.description: Market date the set was calibrated to.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Provenance of the set (vendor delivery or internal generation).

entities.name: valuation_run
entities.title: Valuation Run
entities.description: One execution of a valuation process: which valuation date, which approved assumption sets (one per assumption type, via valuation_run_assumption), which scenario set, which model version, run by whom, with what quality verdict. The run is the unit of auditability - every published valuation result points back to exactly one run.
entities.grain: One row per valuation run execution.

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the run.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Valuation date the run values the book at.

attributes.name: run_timestamp
attributes.description: When the run executed.

attributes.name: scenario_set_id
attributes.description: Scenario set the run used, for stochastic runs.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version of the valuation model/engine used (e.g. a Unity Catalog model version).

attributes.name: run_verdict_code
attributes.description: Quality-gate verdict; RED runs never feed published results.

attributes.name: run_by
attributes.description: Operator or service principal that executed the run.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System that executed the run.

entities.name: valuation_run_assumption
entities.title: Valuation Run Assumption
entities.description: Which assumption sets a valuation run used - one row per assumption set, typically one per assumption type (mortality, lapse, expense, economic). This junction is what makes any past result exactly reproducible: run plus sets plus scenario plus model version is the full recipe.
entities.grain: One row per assumption set used by a valuation run.

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: The valuation run.

attributes.name: assumption_set_id
attributes.description: An assumption set the run used.

entities.name: party
entities.title: Party
entities.description: A person or organisation the group deals with. A party exists exactly once regardless of how many relationships it has; what the party does (insured, broker, cedant, claimant...) is expressed through party roles, never by duplicating the party.
entities.grain: One row per unique legal person or organisation, mastered across source systems.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Stable, source-agnostic identifier for the party, owned by the data layer.

attributes.name: party_type_code
attributes.description: Whether the party is a natural person or a legal entity.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the party.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Country of residence or registration.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record this party was mastered from.

entities.name: party_role
entities.title: Party Role
entities.description: A role a party plays in a specific business context - on a policy, a claim or a treaty. This is the model's central extensibility pattern: a new kind of counterparty is a new party_role_type code plus rows here, never a new table.
entities.grain: One row per role a party plays in one context (policy, claim, treaty, quote or submission) for a period of time. Exactly one of policy_id, claim_id, treaty_id, quote_id and submission_id is populated.

standards.acord: PartyRole patterns of the ACORD Information Model

attributes.name: party_role_id
attributes.description: Identifier for this role assignment.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: The party playing the role.

attributes.name: party_role_type_code
attributes.description: Which role the party plays in the context.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Policy context of the role, when the role is played on a policy.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Claim context of the role, when the role is played on a claim.

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Treaty context of the role, when the role is played on a treaty.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Quote context of the role, when the role is played on a quotation.

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Submission context of the role, when the role is played on a reinsurance submission.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the role applies (inclusive).

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the role ceased (inclusive); empty while the role is current.

quality.name: exactly_one_context
quality.rule: exactly one of policy_id, claim_id, treaty_id, quote_id, submission_id is not null
quality.description: A role is always played in exactly one business context.

entities.name: coverage
entities.title: Coverage
entities.description: A specific cover granted under a policy, with its own limit and deductible. A policy bundles one or more coverages; claims attach to coverages where the source data allows it.
entities.grain: One row per coverage granted under a policy.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the coverage.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Policy the coverage is granted under.

attributes.name: coverage_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of cover granted.

attributes.name: limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum amount payable under this coverage, in the policy currency; empty where unlimited or not applicable.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Amount borne by the insured before this coverage responds, in the policy currency.

attributes.name: sum_insured_amount
attributes.description: Declared value insured under this coverage, in the policy currency.

entities.name: endorsement
entities.title: Endorsement
entities.description: A mid-term change to a policy contract. The endorsement records the contractual change; any premium effect is booked as premium transactions referencing the same policy, never stored here.
entities.grain: One row per endorsement per policy.

attributes.name: endorsement_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the endorsement.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Policy being endorsed.

attributes.name: endorsement_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of contractual change.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date the change takes effect (inclusive).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the change as recorded.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record the endorsement originates from.

entities.name: insured_object
entities.title: Insured Object
entities.description: A concrete object or exposure insured under a policy - a building, a vehicle, a shipment, a set of operations. Location lives here, which makes this the anchor for exposure and accumulation analysis.
entities.grain: One row per insured object under a policy.

attributes.name: insured_object_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the insured object.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Policy the object is insured under.

attributes.name: insured_object_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of object or exposure insured.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the object, as declared.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Country where the object is located or the exposure arises.

attributes.name: postcode
attributes.description: Postal code of the object's location, where applicable; drives geographic accumulation.

entities.name: policy
entities.title: Policy
entities.description: A contract of insurance between an insurer and one or more policyholders, under which the insurer provides cover for defined risks in exchange for premium. This is the contract-level record: coverages, insured objects, premium transactions and parties are separate entities that reference it.
entities.grain: One row per policy contract per source system. Mid-term changes are modelled as endorsements (future entity), not as new rows here.

standards.lloyds_cdr: Contract-level attributes of the Lloyd's Core Data Record (indicative)

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Stable, source-agnostic identifier for the policy. A surrogate key owned by the data layer, not by any policy administration system.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number as issued to the policyholder. Unique within a source system, not globally - always interpret together with source_system_code.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record this policy originates from. Provenance is part of the model, not an afterthought.

attributes.name: line_of_business_code
attributes.description: Line of business written under this policy.

attributes.name: policy_status_code
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the policy.

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Date on which cover begins (inclusive).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which cover ends (inclusive). Must be on or after inception_date.

attributes.name: underwriting_year
attributes.description: Year of account to which the policy is allocated; drives reinsurance cession and market reporting.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Original currency of the policy. Monetary amounts on child entities are expressed in this currency unless explicitly stated otherwise.

quality.name: cover_period_valid
quality.description: Cover cannot end before it begins.

entities.name: premium_transaction
entities.title: Premium Transaction
entities.description: A signed premium movement on a policy. Premium is transactional by design: figures such as gross written premium are derived by summing transactions, never stored as overwritable balances.
entities.grain: One row per premium movement per policy (and coverage, where known).

standards.acord: Premium / MoneyProvision patterns of the ACORD Information Model

attributes.name: premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the premium transaction.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Policy the premium movement belongs to.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Coverage the movement is allocated to, where the source provides that split.

attributes.name: premium_transaction_type_code
attributes.description: Kind of premium movement.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Signed amount of the movement in the transaction currency: written and positive adjustments positive, returns negative.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the amount.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Date the movement was booked.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record the movement originates from.

entities.name: quote
entities.title: Quote
entities.description: A quotation for insurance cover. Quotes live upstream of policies: a converted quote links to the policy issued from it, closing the quote-to-policy thread that pricing and underwriting processes work in. Premium only ever arises on the policy.
entities.grain: One row per quotation per source system.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Stable, source-agnostic identifier for the quote, owned by the data layer.

attributes.name: quote_number
attributes.description: Quote reference as issued; unique within a source system.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Policy issued from this quote; populated only when the quote converted.

attributes.name: line_of_business_code
attributes.description: Line of business quoted.

attributes.name: quote_status_code
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the quote.

attributes.name: quote_date
attributes.description: Date the quotation was produced.

attributes.name: requested_inception_date
attributes.description: Cover start date requested by the prospect.

attributes.name: quoted_gross_premium
attributes.description: Gross premium quoted, in the quote currency; empty while the quote is open.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the quoted premium.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record the quote originates from.

entities.name: vehicle
entities.title: Vehicle
entities.description: Motor-specific detail for an insured object of type VEHICLE. This is the model's typed-satellite pattern: the generic insured_object stays lean, and object types that need depth get a satellite entity - vessels, buildings surveys or cyber estates would follow the same shape.
entities.grain: One row per vehicle per insured object.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the vehicle record.

attributes.name: insured_object_id
attributes.description: The insured object this vehicle detail belongs to (object type VEHICLE).

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Vehicle registration mark.

attributes.name: make
attributes.description: Manufacturer.

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Model designation.

attributes.name: year_of_manufacture
attributes.description: Year of manufacture.

entities.name: cat_event
entities.title: Catastrophe Event
entities.description: A named catastrophe event (windstorm, flood...) that losses accumulate against, across the direct book and the treaty portfolio. Event losses - modelled on day one, reported as cedant figures firm up - reference this event.
entities.grain: One row per catastrophe event.

attributes.name: cat_event_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the event.

attributes.name: event_name
attributes.description: Market name of the event (e.g. a named windstorm).

attributes.name: cause_of_loss_code
attributes.description: Primary peril of the event.

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: Date of the event (first landfall or onset).

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Primary country affected, where a single country applies.

attributes.name: industry_loss_estimate
attributes.description: Market-wide insured loss estimate, in the stated currency.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the industry loss estimate.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record the event was registered in.

entities.name: cession
entities.title: Cession
entities.description: The link between direct business and a treaty: which policy (or coverage) is ceded to which treaty, and to what share. Ceded premium and recoveries are derived by applying the ceded share to the underlying transactions.
entities.grain: One row per policy (or coverage, where the split exists) per treaty.

attributes.name: cession_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the cession.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Policy being ceded.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Coverage being ceded, where cession applies at coverage level.

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Treaty the business is ceded to.

attributes.name: ceded_share
attributes.description: Share of the risk ceded under this cession, as a fraction between 0 and 1.

entities.name: event_loss
entities.title: Event Loss
entities.description: A loss figure attributed to a catastrophe event - against a treaty (assumed book) or a policy (direct book). The loss basis keeps modelled day-one estimates and firming cedant reports honestly apart; figures are point-in- time as-of snapshots, never overwritten.
entities.grain: One row per event per treaty-or-policy per basis per as-of date.

attributes.name: event_loss_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the loss row.

attributes.name: cat_event_id
attributes.description: The catastrophe event the loss belongs to.

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Treaty the loss attaches to, for the assumed book.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Policy the loss attaches to, for the direct book.

attributes.name: loss_basis_code
attributes.description: Whether the figure is modelled or reported.

attributes.name: gross_loss_amount
attributes.description: Gross loss to the contract, in the stated currency.

attributes.name: ceded_loss_amount
attributes.description: Portion ceded onward under outward protections, where computed.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the amounts.

attributes.name: as_of_date
attributes.description: Snapshot date of the figure.

quality.name: exactly_one_book
quality.rule: exactly one of treaty_id, policy_id is not null
quality.description: A loss row belongs to either the assumed or the direct book, never both.

entities.name: submission
entities.title: Submission
entities.description: A reinsurance submission: a cedant's (or broker's) request for treaty cover, from receipt through triage, pricing and decision. A bound submission links to the treaty it produced. Cedant and broker are party roles on the submission.
entities.grain: One row per submission per source system.

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Stable identifier for the submission, owned by the data layer.

attributes.name: submission_reference
attributes.description: Submission reference as received; unique within a source system.

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Treaty bound from this submission; populated only when BOUND.

attributes.name: submission_status_code
attributes.description: Lifecycle status from receipt to bind or decline.

attributes.name: treaty_type_code
attributes.description: Form of treaty requested.

attributes.name: line_of_business_code
attributes.description: Class of business the cover is requested for.

attributes.name: underwriting_year
attributes.description: Underwriting year the cover would attach to.

attributes.name: requested_limit
attributes.description: Limit requested, in the submission currency.

attributes.name: requested_attachment
attributes.description: Attachment point requested, for non-proportional forms.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the requested terms.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date the submission was received.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record the submission originates from.

entities.name: treaty
entities.title: Treaty
entities.description: A treaty reinsurance contract under which risks are ceded to or assumed from reinsurers. Cedant and reinsurer are party roles on the treaty; which business it covers is expressed through cessions.
entities.grain: One row per treaty contract per underwriting year.

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Stable identifier for the treaty, owned by the data layer.

attributes.name: treaty_reference
attributes.description: Treaty reference as agreed between the parties.

attributes.name: treaty_type_code
attributes.description: Form of the treaty.

attributes.name: line_of_business_code
attributes.description: Class of business the treaty covers.

attributes.name: underwriting_year
attributes.description: Underwriting year of account of the treaty.

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Date treaty cover begins (inclusive).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date treaty cover ends (inclusive). Must be on or after inception_date.

attributes.name: cession_rate
attributes.description: Contractual ceded share for proportional treaties, as a fraction between 0 and 1; empty for non-proportional forms.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the treaty.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record the treaty originates from.

quality.name: cover_period_valid
quality.description: Treaty cover cannot end before it begins.

entities.name: treaty_layer
entities.title: Treaty Layer
entities.description: A layer of a treaty programme: limit and attachment for non-proportional forms, with reinstatement terms where they apply. Proportional treaties typically have a single layer carrying the ceded share economics on the treaty itself.
entities.grain: One row per layer per treaty.

attributes.name: treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the layer.

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Treaty the layer belongs to.

attributes.name: layer_number
attributes.description: Position of the layer in the programme, 1 = lowest attachment.

attributes.name: limit_amount
attributes.description: Limit of the layer, in the treaty currency.

attributes.name: attachment_amount
attributes.description: Attachment point of the layer; empty for proportional forms.

attributes.name: reinstatement_count
attributes.description: Number of reinstatements available, where applicable.

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_rate
attributes.description: Reinstatement premium as a fraction of the layer premium.

views.name: cession_bordereau_line
views.title: Cession Bordereau Line (outbound)
views.description: The outbound cession bordereau, derived live from the canonical model: one line per policy premium movement ceded to a treaty, with the ceded amount computed from the contractual ceded share. This view - together with the data_dictionary - IS the bordereau: it is shared as a governed table, never exported to a spreadsheet.
views.grain: One row per ceded premium movement per policy per treaty.
views.sql:
SELECT
  tr.treaty_reference,
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pt.transaction_date) AS reporting_month,
  p.policy_number,
  ins.name AS insured_name,
  p.line_of_business_code,
  p.inception_date,
  p.expiry_date,
  pt.currency_code,
  pt.amount AS gross_premium,
  ces.ceded_share,
  CAST(ROUND(pt.amount * ces.ceded_share, 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS ceded_premium
FROM {reinsurance.cession} ces
JOIN {policy.policy} p ON p.policy_id = ces.policy_id
JOIN {reinsurance.treaty} tr ON tr.treaty_id = ces.treaty_id
JOIN {policy.premium_transaction} pt ON pt.policy_id = p.policy_id
LEFT JOIN {party.party_role} pr
  ON pr.policy_id = p.policy_id AND pr.party_role_type_code = 'INSURED'
LEFT JOIN {party.party} ins ON ins.party_id = pr.party_id

views.name: financial_transaction
views.title: Financial Transaction (unified)
views.description: Unified view of all financial movements - premium and claim transactions - with their policy context, so portfolio metrics that span premium and claims (such as loss ratio) can be defined over a single source. Amounts are in original transaction currency.
views.grain: One row per premium or claim transaction.
views.sql:
SELECT
  p.policy_id,
  p.underwriting_year,
  p.line_of_business_code,
  pt.currency_code,
  pt.transaction_date,
  'PREMIUM' AS transaction_kind,
  pt.premium_transaction_type_code AS transaction_type_code,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS claim_id,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS cause_of_loss_code,
  pt.amount
FROM {policy.premium_transaction} pt
JOIN {policy.policy} p ON p.policy_id = pt.policy_id
UNION ALL
SELECT
  p.policy_id,
  p.underwriting_year,
  p.line_of_business_code,
  ct.currency_code,
  ct.transaction_date,
  'CLAIM' AS transaction_kind,
  ct.claim_transaction_type_code AS transaction_type_code,
  c.claim_id,
  c.cause_of_loss_code,
  ct.amount
FROM {claim.claim_transaction} ct
JOIN {claim.claim} c ON c.claim_id = ct.claim_id
JOIN {policy.policy} p ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id

metric_views.name: cession_metrics
metric_views.title: Cession Metrics
metric_views.description: Outward reinsurance KPIs over the cession bordereau: gross and ceded premium by treaty and period. Amounts are in original transaction currency; group by or filter on currency_code before summing money. Query measures with MEASURE(name).

dimensions.name: treaty_reference
dimensions.description: Treaty the premium is ceded to.

dimensions.name: reporting_month
dimensions.description: Bordereau reporting month.

dimensions.name: line_of_business
dimensions.description: Line of business as its business label, e.g. 'Commercial Property'. Filter with labels; use line_of_business_code for codes.

dimensions.name: line_of_business_code
dimensions.description: Line of business as its code, e.g. COMMERCIAL_PROPERTY.

dimensions.name: currency_code
dimensions.description: Original currency of the amounts. Group by this before summing money.

measures.name: gross_premium
measures.description: Gross premium on the ceded policies, in original currency.

measures.name: ceded_premium
measures.description: Premium ceded to reinsurers, in original currency.

measures.name: average_ceded_share
measures.description: Effective ceded share - ceded premium over gross premium.

measures.name: ceded_policy_count
measures.description: Number of distinct policies with ceded premium.

metric_views.name: submission_metrics
metric_views.title: Submission Metrics
metric_views.description: Reinsurance submission funnel KPIs: volumes and requested capacity by status, form and year. Amounts are in original submission currency; group by or filter on currency_code before summing money. Query measures with MEASURE(name).

dimensions.name: underwriting_year
dimensions.description: Underwriting year the cover would attach to.

dimensions.name: submission_status
dimensions.description: Funnel status as its business label.

dimensions.name: treaty_type_code
dimensions.description: Form of treaty requested.

dimensions.name: line_of_business
dimensions.description: Line of business as its business label, e.g. 'Commercial Property'. Filter with labels; use line_of_business_code for codes.

dimensions.name: line_of_business_code
dimensions.description: Line of business as its code, e.g. COMMERCIAL_PROPERTY.

dimensions.name: currency_code
dimensions.description: Original currency of requested terms. Group by this before summing money.

measures.name: bound_count
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN submission_status_code = 'BOUND' THEN submission_id END)

measures.name: bind_ratio
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN submission_status_code = 'BOUND' THEN submission_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT submission_id), 0)

measures.name: requested_limit_total
measures.description: Total limit requested, in original currency.

metric_views.name: underwriting_metrics
metric_views.title: Underwriting Metrics
metric_views.description: Certified underwriting KPIs - premium, claims development and loss ratio - defined once over the canonical model. Measures are in original transaction currency: always group by or filter on currency_code before summing money. Query measures with MEASURE(name).

dimensions.name: underwriting_year
dimensions.description: Underwriting year of account of the underlying policy.

dimensions.name: line_of_business
dimensions.description: Line of business as its business label, e.g. 'Commercial Property'. Filter this dimension with labels; use line_of_business_code for codes.

dimensions.name: line_of_business_code
dimensions.description: Line of business as its code, e.g. COMMERCIAL_PROPERTY.

dimensions.name: currency_code
dimensions.description: Original currency of the transaction. Group by this before summing money.

dimensions.name: transaction_month
dimensions.description: Calendar month the movement was booked in.

dimensions.name: cause_of_loss_code
dimensions.description: Cause of loss for claim movements; empty for premium movements.

measures.name: gross_written_premium
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_kind = 'PREMIUM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Sum of all premium movements (written, adjustments, returns) - the book's gross written premium in original currency.

measures.name: claims_paid
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type_code IN ('INDEMNITY_PAYMENT', 'EXPENSE_PAYMENT') THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Indemnity plus allocated expense paid, gross of recoveries.

measures.name: recoveries
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type_code = 'RECOVERY' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Subrogation, salvage and contribution recoveries (negative amounts).

measures.name: outstanding_reserve
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type_code = 'CASE_RESERVE_MOVEMENT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Current case reserves - the sum of all signed reserve movements.

measures.name: claims_incurred
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_kind = 'CLAIM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Paid plus outstanding net of recoveries - total claims incurred.

measures.name: loss_ratio
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_kind = 'CLAIM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_kind = 'PREMIUM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
measures.description: Claims incurred divided by gross written premium. Meaningful within a single currency; not premium-earned-adjusted in this version.

measures.name: policy_count
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_kind = 'PREMIUM' THEN policy_id END)
measures.description: Number of distinct policies with premium activity.

measures.name: claim_count
measures.description: Number of distinct claims with financial activity.

metric_views.name: valuation_metrics
metric_views.title: Valuation Metrics
metric_views.description: Published valuation figures (BEL, technical provisions, SCR, CSM...) by run, measure and line of business - one semantic surface across life and non-life, Solvency II and IFRS 17. Amounts are in original currency; group by or filter on currency_code and valuation_measure_code before summing. Query measures with MEASURE(name).

dimensions.name: valuation_date
dimensions.description: Valuation date of the producing run.

dimensions.name: valuation_measure_code
dimensions.description: Which defined measure the figure is (BEL, SCR, CSM...). Always constrain this before summing.

dimensions.name: line_of_business
dimensions.description: Line of business as its business label, e.g. 'Term Life'. Filter this dimension with labels; use line_of_business_code for codes.

dimensions.name: line_of_business_code
dimensions.description: Line of business as its code, e.g. TERM_LIFE.

dimensions.name: cohort
dimensions.description: Optional sub-division of the figure.

dimensions.name: currency_code
dimensions.description: Original currency. Group by this before summing money.

measures.name: total_amount
measures.description: Sum of the figures - only meaningful within one measure and one currency.

measures.name: run_count
measures.description: Number of distinct producing runs represented.
